contract.input_domain: Finite rational bivariate polynomials and rational rectangular domains within declared degree/refinement/work limits. Extend finite-fiber set topology from square-free generic fibers to repeated factors; retain original defining equations, exact factor powers and their scalar unit. This increment does not declare arbitrary algebraic coefficient or vertical-component support complete.
contract.missing_acceptance: F^2 and F^3 for already admitted circles, parabolas, nodes, cusps and isolated points; mixed powers with crossings. Original source equation, topology, differential meaning, exact incidence, region/replay and subsequent operations must remain intact.
contract.required_semantics: Separate geometric reduced support from original defining multiplicities. Do not replace equation() meaning or serialize trusted multiplicity flags. Exact factor/division relations and reconstruction authorize support reduction; replay rebuilds and validates them. Contact/local intersection multiplicity is distinct from repeated defining-factor exponent.
contract.resource_contract: Respect the topology degree/refinement and shared work limits. Do not use unbounded component-discovery continuations to bypass configured projection limits. Report unsupported/undecided/actual exhaustion distinctly. These existing counters are not total arithmetic/bit-size/memory bounds.
contract.baseline_status: Valid baseline2: all six acceptance cases execute and fail RepeatedComponent on unchanged6296155 production source. Baseline1 only had an import compile error and is retained separately as invalid evidence.
downstream_obligations: Keep existing malformed-input and resource fixtures; strengthen previously blocked repeated-factor fixtures to exact success on their original inputs.
Use reduced support for geometric derivatives and incidence while preserving original source/factor evidence.
Exercise Hypercurve region operations and native SVG, BRep section/interchange consumers, replay and further operation.
Run affected full local/downstream checks and complete workflow pre-push gate before publishing.

closure_argument.domain: Q[x,y], nonzero finite polynomial and admitted rational rectangle; the topology retains its existing configured dimension/refinement and shared work limits.
closure_argument.radical: In characteristic zero, F=c product(p_i^m_i) has gcd(F,F_x,F_y)=product(p_i^(m_i-1)) up to a nonzero rational unit. Using both derivatives preserves simple axis components; no extracted axis content is saturated away.
closure_argument.gcd: Exact axis-content gcds are accumulated. Exact-dividing generic common components are removed from both residuals until a nonzero resultant proves generic coprimality. Axis-content exhaustion plus that resultant establishes a full bivariate gcd. Every removal decreases stored bidegree, and bounded component discovery keeps configured projection limits.
closure_argument.powers: Starting with W=F/gcd and G=gcd, successive Y=gcd(W,G), Z=W/Y, G=G/Y and W=Y collect factors of exponent1,2,... . Scalar normalization is retained. Exact polynomial reconstruction verifies F=c product(Z_i^i). A reduced-support decomposition must complete without another repeated-factor reduction.
closure_argument.selection: Every multiplicity factor divides the geometric support. At a singleton selected ordinate, exact retained-field sign proves membership. Otherwise a complete closed-fiber count inside its certified isolator identifies the same root. Open-slab branches select exactly one factor group; factor intersections are projection events, so membership persists through the connected slab. Events retain every incident factor group.
closure_argument.geometry: Point construction and native replay retain original source equations. Derivatives, intersection elimination, component quotients and interval projection consume the checked support. Defining exponent is separate from curve winding and local singular/intersection order.
closure_argument.plane_sections: For an interior regular plane/tensor pullback branch with both sides admitted, an even defining exponent keeps the signed plane value on the same side; an odd exponent changes side. Higher order is not a transversality certificate. Plane-section metadata retains this distinction, and exact pcurves reconstruct factor evidence on native replay.
closure_argument.review_limit: This argument supports the implemented rational factor reduction. It is not a proof of arbitrary algebraic-coefficient topology, vertical-component admission, general operation closure, total arithmetic/memory bounds or universal practical completion.

review.implementation_review: Reduction uses gcd(F,F_x,F_y), retaining axis content, a rational unit and increasing factor powers. Exact reconstruction and generic square-free support establish the source zero set. Event/root memberships use exact retained-field signs for singleton roots and closed-fiber counts otherwise. Geometry consumes the reduced support; point and archive authorities keep the original polynomial. No sampling, new geometry carrier, trusted serialized factor flag or unbounded component-discovery continuation was added.
review.full_target: General algebraic coefficients, vertical components, full implicit operations and distinct total work/memory/cancellation contracts remain open.
completed_review_actions: Qualify BRep parity documentation by both sides being admitted by the parameter domain.
Restore the unchanged original unit-test coefficient source in polynomial_curve_selected_circle.rs.
Describe geometric-support roots as simple without claiming original repeated fibers are simple.
Add a cubic plane/tensor contact to distinguish higher odd multiplicity from transverse crossing.

baseline: Six solver cases fail RepeatedComponent on unchanged production source. With only the owner reduction, five consumer cases execute and fail differential, incidence or region admission. Compile-only failed attempts and the interrupted review attempt are retained without runtime credit.
independent_evidence: Exact factor powers and reconstruction; independent univariate Sturm fiber counts; exact graph jets and mixed component contacts; original-polynomial equations at selected chord cuts; exact chord setbacks; source-preserving region identities; even and odd signed plane values; whole pcurve image validation and fresh-process replay followed by further operation.
selection: Original polynomial definitions and selected root/fiber dependencies remain authoritative. Geometric consumers use checked reduced support. Event roots retain every factor membership; each open-slab branch retains its defining exponent. Defining exponents do not replace winding, local intersection order or transversality.
resources: Configured projection-degree and shared work limits remain active; exact reduction does not call complete component-discovery continuations. Degree refusal and exhaustion during factor reduction allow larger retries. Degree, refinement and promotion counters do not bound total arithmetic, coefficient growth, retained memory or cancellation.
cost_limits: Recorded Cargo command wall times and maximum process RSS include builds and child processes. Existing allocation lifetime checks are regression coverage, not a matched repeated-factor benchmark. No speedup or total resource bound is claimed.
limits: This is rational finite-fiber multiplicity admission, not arbitrary algebraic-coefficient or vertical-component topology, complete implicit operations, curved solids or full pre-push qualification. The parallel zero-distance correction is not part of this source.
